trips.title: Naivasha Weekender
trips.description: Spend your mornings hacking it out on Gary Player’s coastal links and your nights exploring the vibrant, neon-lit souks and luxury rooftop lounges of Morocco.

trips.title: ⁠Road to Turkey Sigona
trips.description: Championship-grade golf tucked away in the lush Hua Hin foothills, rounded out with private villa pool parties, street food safaris, and ultimate tropical relaxation.

trips.title: ⁠Road to Morroco
trips.description: Tee off on East Africa’s only PGA-accredited course alongside wild roaming zebras, then head down to a private Indian Ocean beach club for fresh seafood and sunset DJ sets.
